# n8n: Token exchange access token (OEM embedding, preview)

`n8n-4` · Federated identity · person or service. A partner backend signs a short-lived JWT; n8n verifies it against trusted keys and returns a bearer access token (or a session cookie for iframe SSO).

Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant. "No docs found" means vendor documentation does not say either way.

| Question | Answer | Why | How |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identify: Admin can list all of them | Partial | No token list; issued tokens are visible only through n8n.audit.token-exchange.* audit events. | Where: No list. Settings > Log Streaming > Events: Audit > Token exchange succeeded (n8n.audit.token-exchange.succeeded) |
| Protect: Admin can block or require approval | Yes (requires Enterprise) | N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_ENABLED | Command: Leave N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_ENABLED unset or not true (endpoint returns 501); Cloud: ask n8n support |
| Protect: SSO and MFA rules apply | Partial | Issuance requires a JWT signed by the partner's trusted IdP/backend; n8n's own SSO settings are not described as applying. | Command: Set N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_TRUSTED_KEYS to your IdP/backend key sources with issuer, expectedAudience and allowedRoles |
| Protect: IP restriction | No docs found | Only per-IP rate limits on the exchange endpoint are documented. |  |
| Protect: Expires automatically | Yes | Min of subject/actor JWT lifetime and N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_MAX_TOKEN_TTL (default 15 min) | API: POST /rest/auth/oauth/token response field expires_in · Command: N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_MAX_TOKEN_TTL=<seconds> (default 900) |
| Detect: Usage appears in logs | Yes | not documented | Where: Settings > Log Streaming > Add new destination > Events: n8n.audit.token-exchange.* (Enterprise) |
| Detect: Data reads appear in logs | No docs found | Vendor docs neither confirm nor deny. |  |
| Respond: Revocation ends active access | Not available | Issued tokens stay valid until expiry (default max 15 min). |  |
| Respond: Stops working when user is removed | No docs found | No vendor documentation found. |  |

## Protect: what an admin can configure

### Admin controls
- **allowedRoles (trusted key source)** (Limit scope; Enterprise; default unknown). Restricts which roles token exchange may assign. Where: N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_TRUSTED_KEYS entry.
- **N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_MAX_TOKEN_TTL** (Limit lifetime; Enterprise; default on). Caps issued token lifetime. Where: Environment variable.
- **N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_ENABLED** (Disable; Enterprise; default off). Token exchange is off unless this environment variable is true; the endpoint then returns 501. The preview flag N8N_ENV_FEAT_TOKEN_EXCHANGE must also be set to turn it on. Where: Environment variable N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_ENABLED: leave unset or false to keep it off (Cloud: ask n8n support).

### Not available (vendor states)
- Removing a compromised signing key does not end already-issued tokens or sessions.
- OAuth scope and resource in the exchange request are not enforced.

- Network: unknown (checked at unknown). Only per-IP rate limits on the exchange endpoint are documented.
- Lifetime: Min of subject/actor JWT lifetime and N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_MAX_TOKEN_TTL (default 15 min). Renewal: Mint a new external JWT (jti is single-use) and exchange again.
- Keyless option: supported. RFC 8693 exchange using static public keys or a JWKS URL in N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_TRUSTED_KEYS. Requested scope is recorded but not enforced.
- Conditions: Enterprise; Cloud requires n8n support to enable.

## Detect: what gets logged
- Token prefix: not established

### Logs
- Log streaming: n8n.audit.token-exchange.*: Enterprise.

### Fields that identify the credential
- `not documented` (token exchange events): Scope and resource are recorded in audit events per the page.

### Lifecycle events
- create: `n8n.audit.token-exchange.succeeded` 
- create: `n8n.audit.token-exchange.failed` With failure reason.
- other: `n8n.audit.token-exchange.user-provisioned` JIT user created.

### Correlate on
`userId`

### API calls a holder can make, and whether they are logged
- collection (bulk): `GET /api/v1/workflows (Authorization: Bearer)`. Workflows visible to the acting user Logged: unknown. 

### What to look for (analyst guidance)
- Exchanges assigning global:admin
- User provisioned for unexpected email

## Respond: how to revoke it


Remove the trusted key entry; set N8N_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_ENABLED=false. Live access ends on revocation: no. Issued tokens stay valid until expiry (default max 15 min).
